verdict.rationale: Datadog documents an extensive REST API Reference (datadog-docs-24) alongside a full product suite (monitors, dashboards, SLOs, logs, incidents, etc.), and an official CLI exists (datadog-probe-4), suggesting broad API coverage of platform features. However, there is no explicit evidence confirming full UI/API parity, and probes for a standard OpenAPI spec at expected doc paths returned 404s (datadog-probe-2), leaving completeness unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation or changelog showing all UI actions are API-accessible, discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent confirmation from developers that no UI-only features exist.
